title: Add Test Script to package.json
description: Add a 'test' script to package.json to enable running the test suite with a single command.
details:
- Edit package.json to include: "test": "jest --watch" under scripts.
- Ensure the script uses the correct Jest binary and works cross-platform.
test_strategy: Run 'npm test' or 'yarn test' and verify that Jest runs in watch mode and discovers test files.

title: Write a Simple Component Test for Button
description: Create a basic test file for a simple UI component (e.g., components/ui/button.tsx) to validate the testing setup.
details:
- Locate a stateless, client-side component such as components/ui/button.tsx.
- Create a test file (e.g., components/ui/button.test.tsx) alongside the component.
- Write a test that renders the button and asserts it displays the correct text using React Testing Library and jest-dom matchers.
test_strategy: Run 'npm test' and confirm the test passes. Intentionally break the test to verify it fails, ensuring the setup is robust.

title: Validate and Document Testing Setup
description: Verify the entire testing infrastructure works and document the process for future contributors.
details:
- Run the test suite to ensure all tests pass and the setup is stable.
- Add a short section to README.md describing how to run tests and where to find example tests.
- Optionally, note any caveats or troubleshooting tips discovered during setup.
test_strategy: Check that all tests pass. Review documentation for clarity and accuracy. Ask a teammate to follow the instructions to confirm usability.

title: Install and Configure Jest with React Testing Library for Next.js
description: Set up Jest and React Testing Library for a Next.js App Router project using TypeScript. Ensure compatibility with Next.js conventions, TypeScript path aliases, and CSS imports.
details:
- Add devDependencies: jest, jest-environment-jsdom, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, ts-jest, @types/jest, next/jest.
- Create jest.config.js at the project root using next/jest to generate the config, ensuring support for TypeScript and Next.js path aliases (e.g., @/components).
- Configure setupFilesAfterEnv to point to jest.setup.js.
- Ensure CSS modules and static assets are mocked appropriately.
- Update tsconfig.json to include 'jest' in the types array if necessary.
test_strategy: Run 'npx jest --showConfig' to verify configuration. Confirm that Jest recognizes TypeScript files, path aliases, and can import CSS without errors. Run 'npm test' to ensure Jest starts without failures.

title: Create Jest Setup File for Custom Matchers
description: Establish a jest.setup.js file to configure the testing environment and import custom matchers from React Testing Library.
details:
- Create jest.setup.js at the project root.
- Import '@testing-library/jest-dom' to enable extended DOM matchers for assertions.
- Reference this setup file in jest.config.js via setupFilesAfterEnv.
test_strategy: Run a sample test that uses a custom matcher (e.g., 'toBeInTheDocument') to confirm setup is effective.
